mentions.name: dushed
mentions.description: A personal knowledge management web app that combines flashcards, bookmarks, notes, web feeds, files, and Kindle highlights into one place, letting users access all their knowledge sources together and link sources to one another.
mentions.problem: The author's flashcard material came from everywhere: books on Google Drive, blog posts in a bookmark manager, Kindle highlights, Wikipedia, and notes spread across email and notebooks — with the cards in one app and their sources in five others, which was overwhelming.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on dushed[1]. It's a personal knowledge management web app that combines flashcards, bookmarks, notes, web feeds, files and Kindle highlights into one.
mentions.author: komuW
